use_case: Small mildly-damp basement (≤1500 sq ft); continuous gravity-hose drain to floor drain; quiet; optimize value; weight reliability + energy
notes: Floor drain sits at/below the unit, so a gravity hose works — no built-in pump required (skipping the pump removes the most common failure point, which supports the reliability priority). Cold-basement performance and smart features are NOT priorities. Do NOT artificially penalize high-capacity (50-pint) units — let noise/energy/value buckets self-penalize them. Cheaper is better. Deliverable includes a price-vs-performance Pareto curve.

context.drain: floor drain at or below unit level; continuous gravity hose downhill to the drain
context.ambient_temp: cool (basement) — low-temp operation relevant but not prioritized

budget_usd.note: hard cap $350; cheaper is better (value weight raised to reflect this)

must_haves.label: Continuous gravity-drain hose port (drains downhill to a floor drain, no pump needed)

dealbreakers.label: Compressor/unit failure pattern within ~2 years
dealbreakers.test: critical reviews + Reddit show a recurring early-death pattern

dealbreakers.label: Louder than its class / whine or rattle
dealbreakers.test: measured dB high OR 'much louder than expected' is a recurring 3-star theme

dealbreakers.label: Hose/drain connection leaks or bucket sensor falsely trips and stops the unit

nice_to_haves.label: Auto-restart after power loss (so it doesn't stay off after a blip)

scoring_notes.capacity_fit: Reward units that comfortably cover ≤1500 sq ft mildly damp; penalize ONLY undersizing. Do not penalize high capacity — noise/energy/value handle that.
scoring_notes.value: Cheaper is strictly better at equal performance; hard cap $350.

deliverables: price-vs-performance Pareto curve (perf = weighted non-price score: noise+reliability+energy+capacity+drainage)

conviction.notes: Pick: Midea Cube 20-pint (~$199). Runner-up: hOmeLabs 35 (~$220). Tradeoff = quiet+efficiency vs proven longevity. 50-pint+pump rejected on confirmed early-death dealbreaker.
